title: Recipe Unlocks
summary: A locked recipe is usually a message, not a wall.
body: Recipes may require research, mission state, item discovery, or chapter progress.
TutorialCore can explain common locks, but the owning addon remains authoritative.
steps: Read the lock reason when a recipe fails.
Scan the related machine or item with Lens.
commonMistakes: Crafting the same locked recipe repeatedly.
